decisions.reason: The fully visible native disclosure button has the first glyph of each wrapped line visibly cut by its rounded leading corners in the original PNG. Other required text is present across the complete state sweep. This is visible glyph clipping, independent of native ellipsized=false.

The disclosure text occupies the rounded clipping area of its native button: the leading portions of the first glyphs are visibly occluded although the entire button is inside the viewport. Other controls remain separated. This shares one root cause with the wrapping failure.
